2607.09578.title: Knowledge Graphs and Explainable AI as Complementary Resources for Urban Mining
2607.09578.paper_summary: Pre-demolition assessment, the regulated audit process at the heart of urban mining, is an information process in which AI support must serve qualified auditors who remain accountable for the decisions taken. The relevant unit of value is not prediction accuracy alone, but the defensibility of the supported decisions: their legibility, plausibility, sourcing, and contestability. Explainable AI techniques and domain knowledge graphs each address parts of this requirement, and existing taxonomies have catalogued their integration. The literature is descriptively rich but structurally under-specified: what remains less developed is a structural account of why specific integrations produce artefacts neither resource can provide alone. This paper offers a complementarity-theoretic interpretation grounded in the IS resource-based tradition. We propose four consolidated KG-XAI integration modes (Lifting, Constraining, Typing, and Revising), each defined as a typed operation over XAI artefacts and knowledge-graph substrate structures. Each mode unlocks a distinct property of defensibility and contributes to the kind of regulatory artefact pre-demolition assessment demands. A fire-door example from the urban-mining process illustrates the modes using the W3C Linked Building Data stack and valuation extensions.
2607.09578.paper_summary_zh: 預拆除評估，作為城市採礦核心的受規範審核過程，是一個資訊過程，其中 AI 支持必須服務於對所做決策負責的合格審核員。相關的價值單位不僅是預測準確性，而是所支持決策的可辯護性：它們的可讀性、可信性、來源和可爭議性。可解釋的 AI 技術和領域知識圖譜各自解決了這一要求的部分，而現有的分類法已經對它們的整合進行了編目。文獻在描述上非常豐富，但在結構上則不夠明確：尚未發展出具體的結構性說明，為何特定的整合會產生單獨的資源無法提供的工件。本文提供了一種基於 IS 資源基礎傳統的互補性理論解釋。我們提出了四種整合模式的 KG-XAI（提升、約束、類型化和修訂），每種模式都被定義為對 XAI 工件和知識圖譜基礎結構的類型化操作。每種模式解鎖了可辯護性的獨特屬性，並有助於滿足預拆除評估所需的監管工件。來自城市採礦過程的防火門示例使用 W3C 連結建築數據堆疊和估值擴展來說明這些模式。
